concerns.text: Phase 0 (Data Availability Check) is not referenced by any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the spec; it is an extra step not required by the specification.
Phase 8 (Reporting & Figures) produces visual outputs but the spec does not list a corresponding FR or SC for figure generation; this constitutes plan over‑reach.
Phase 9 runs a lint check and contract tests, yet the specification contains no FR or SC that mandates linting or contract verification; this is an additional activity beyond the spec.
Phase 10 (Runtime Guard) adapts runtime if a phase exceeds 5 h, but the spec does not require such a guard; it is an extra safeguard not tied to any FR/SC.

The “Dataset Strategy” table lists verified source URLs that **do not contain** the required resting‑state fMRI time‑series or NIH Toolbox Dimensional Change Card Sort scores (e.g., “https://huggingface.co/datasets/7eu7d7/HCP-Diffusion-datas/...”, “https://huggingface.co/datasets/timm/nih-chest-xray-14/...”). These datasets are unrelated (diffusion MRI or chest‑X‑ray data), making them inappropriate for the research question. The plan’s Phase 0 data‑gap check will inevitably fail, preventing any downstream analysis.

The plan outputs `null_validation.csv` containing `Null_Model_P`, but the `Dataset Schema` (contracts/dataset.schema.yaml) requires a `Null_Model_P` column in the final subject‑level CSV (`final_results.csv`). The plan does not state that this column will be merged into `final_results.csv`, creating a contract violation.

The `RSFC_Variability` entity in `data-model.md` includes a `Motion_Noise_Residual` attribute, yet the plan never mentions generating or storing this residual metric. This leaves the entity under‑specified and may cause schema validation failures.

Phase 7 describes assembling `final_results.csv` but does not list all required columns from the `Dataset Schema` (e.g., `Null_Model_P`, `Motion_Noise_Residual`). Clarify that these fields will be incorporated from earlier phases.
